# Sensei Group

> World-class fractional talent on demand.

## About
Sensei Group is a fractional talent network. Companies describe what they need,
matching finds pre-vetted candidates, and the work starts in days. The network
covers engineering, design, product, marketing, AI/ML and architecture.

## How it works
- Share your needs: describe the role and the work
- Matching: candidates are proposed from the network
- Meet and interview: talk to vetted people
- Start working: onboard and scale the team
